title: 咆哮のクロノス ―嘘なき拳と壊れた秒針―
author: 甲斐 走

en.title: The Roaring Chronos: The Honest Fist and the Broken Second Hand
en.premise: Ren is a boy burdened by a 'curse' that makes it impossible for him to use 'feints'—the lies of boxing. Clutching a stopped pocket watch left by his late father, he continues to fight in the ring using nothing but raw, direct offense. In a world of boxing dominated by deception and technique, can he put his own 'truth' into his fists and set the stopped time in motion once more?

zh.title: 咆哮的克洛诺斯 ―无谎之拳与破碎的秒针―
zh.premise: 少年莲背负着在拳击比赛中完全无法使用“假动作（谎言）”的“诅咒”。他紧握着亡父留下的那块停止走动的怀表，仅凭毫无掩饰的正攻法在擂台上奋战。在欺瞒与技巧主宰的拳击界，他能否将自己的“真实”倾注于拳头之中，让停滞的时间再次转动？
